contract: The normal published SDK author requests 5.25 seconds of durable sleep, which rounds to six whole seconds. The original process stops after its actual scheduling commit; a distinct cold process consumes the same original timer and completes the same run. Preserve timer identity, sequence, deadline, full history prefixes, original task/run/queue/lease authority, real committed receipts and exact int64/Unicode/null Avro values. Firing cannot be early, replay cannot reschedule, and no activity or replacement run is created. Embedded executes a canonical PHP author and labels SDK language transport inapplicable.
